steps.code:
# Parse all notes to extract date and practiced_good_posture value
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

habit_data = []
for note in notes_data:
    title = note['title']
    content = note['content']
    # Extract date from title
    m = re.search(r'Habit Tracking Log for (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    # Extract practiced_good_posture value
    m2 = re.search(r'practiced_good_posture:\s*(\w+)', content)
    if not m2:
        continue
    posture = m2.group(1).strip().lower()
    habit_data.append({'date': date_str, 'posture': posture})

# Sort by date
habit_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])
print(f"Total habit entries: {len(habit_data)}")
print("First few:")
for h in habit_data[:5]:
    print(h)
